body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Philips is expanding its acclaimed collection with its home theater system ‘HTS6515’ unveiled at CES 2008.
The HTS6515 integrates the latest audio technology with a multi-channel amplifier, DVD player and iPod® dock. This is packaged in a sleek and brand new design.

This new product build on the already successful and positive reputation of Philips' HTS6600, featuring Ambisound technology, which boasts HDMI™ connectivity with true high-definition video up-conversion, representing the future in home theater innovation.
Philips' HTS6515D will be available in May 2008 and its MSRP is to be 499(USD).
